> 
> "Shouldn't there [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/be be] a {nu'u} in front of {gi}?  (CLL Chap[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/ter ter] 14, example 11..7)" 
> 
>   I wasn't really sure.  He may very well be right.  Both parse, but I'm not sure exactly the difference is semantically (and jbofi'e doesn't handle tagged termsets), so I was wondering if some kind jbocre can help us out here?

"Tagged termsets" or "tagged-term sets"? The former are not grammatical.

Anyway, "nu'u" makes no difference, it's an elidable terminator, and 
there are two of them, one for each termset:

nu'i ge tecu'u ro selje'a sepi'o lo selyle'u pe ri [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/nu'u nu'u] gi tecu'u 
ro natmi bau lo bangu be ri [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/nu'u nu'u]

mu'o mi'e xorxes
